description: Department of Forest Conservation - Order Declare the State lands of the Galkadawala Reserved forest from 7th August 2024.
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a Reserved Forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance and notification of its control under the Conservator General of Forests. It constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it exercises powers under existing legislation (Forest Conservation Ordinance) to create new protected areas and establish administrative control, making it a statutory instrument rather than a government personnel or structural change.
